review_method: Rendered Apple HIG pages were matched to canonical rules by official URL, section path, source hash, and source sentence hash; surrounding guidance was reviewed without persisting full source prose.

decision_policy.must: Retain MUST for an unqualified Always, Be sure, Ensure, Make sure, Must, or You must directive after checking its surrounding conditions and exceptions. Preserve accessibility, privacy, safety, security, user-intent, and platform-contract requirements at MUST.
decision_policy.must_not: Retain MUST_NOT for an explicit Never, must not, cannot or can't, Always avoid, or named prohibition after checking its surrounding conditions and exceptions.
decision_policy.mixed_strength: Split or narrow a candidate when mandatory and optional clauses occur in the same source lead; do not promote consider guidance to MUST.

statement.en: Require exactly one modifier key to reveal a dynamic menu item.

HIG-COMPONENTS-THE-MENU-BAR-0024.title: Ensure full-screen iPad app functions remain accessible through the UI

HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0001.title: Adapt windows fluidly across supported sizes

HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0006.title: Prevent iPadOS window controls from overlapping toolbar items

statement.en: Ensure iPadOS window controls do not overlap toolbar items.
statement.ja: iPadOSのwindow controlがtoolbar itemと重ならないようにする。

conditions: In windowed mode, move leading toolbar buttons inward when window controls appear.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0006.review_note: Retained MUST after confirming the explicit Make sure lead and the windowed-toolbar mitigation.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0008.title: Match system-defined macOS window-state appearances

statement.en: Ensure custom macOS windows use the system-defined appearance for each window state.
statement.ja: custom macOS windowで各window stateのsystem-defined appearanceを使う。

conditions: Update custom backgrounds and controls when the window changes between main, key, and inactive states.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0008.review_note: Retained MUST after confirming the explicit Make sure lead and state-dependent appearance requirement.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0022.title: Support multiple iPadOS windows when presenting a single file

statement.en: Support multiple windows in an iPadOS app that presents a single file without creating a custom window.

conditions: The app presents one file without creating its own window.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0021.title: Ensure app-icon gradients respond to system lighting

conditions: The requirement applies only when the background uses a gradient.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0021.review_note: Recovered the conditional Ensure requirement without applying it to solid backgrounds.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0022.title: Ensure imported app-icon backgrounds are full-bleed and opaque

statement.en: When importing an app-icon background layer, ensure it is full-bleed and opaque.
statement.ja: app icon background layerをimportする場合はfull-bleedかつopaqueにする。

conditions: For iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and watchOS icons, Icon Composer solid colors and gradients usually avoid the need for an imported background.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0022.review_note: Recovered the conditional Make sure requirement and preserved the no-import default.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0029.title: Keep tvOS app-icon text above other layers

statement.en: When a tvOS app icon includes text, ensure it appears above the other layers.
statement.ja: tvOS app iconにtextを含める場合は他のlayerより上に配置する。

conditions: Keep text above parallax layers so the system doesn't crop it.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0029.review_note: Recovered the conditional Make sure tvOS text-layer requirement.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0031.title: Ensure app-icon artwork avoids fragile lines and corners

statement.en: Ensure app-icon artwork avoids extremely thin lines and sharp corners.
statement.ja: app icon artworkで極端に細いlineやsharp cornerを避ける。

conditions: Thin lines and sharp corners lose detail and crispness at small sizes and low resolutions.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0031.review_note: Recovered the explicit Make sure to avoid requirement as a positive MUST outcome.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0032.title: Ensure custom app-icon effects don't conflict with system effects

statement.en: When using custom app-icon effects, ensure they appear as expected and don't conflict with system effects.
statement.ja: custom app icon effectを使う場合は意図どおり表示されsystem effectと競合しないようにする。

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0032.review_note: Recovered the conditional Make sure verification outcome without requiring custom effects.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0035.title: Keep alternate app icons related to the app experience

statement.en: When offering alternate app icons, ensure each remains closely related to the app's content and experience.
statement.ja: alternate app iconを提供する場合、各iconをapp contentとexperienceに密接に関連させる。

conditions: The app offers alternate icons on iOS, iPadOS, tvOS, or as a compatible app running in visionOS.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0035.review_note: Recovered the conditional Make sure identity requirement and narrowed supported platforms.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-BRANDING-0008.title: Ensure custom fonts remain legible and support text accessibility

statement.en: When using a custom font, ensure it remains legible at all sizes and supports Bold Text and larger type.
statement.ja: custom fontを使う場合、すべてのsizeでlegibleにしBold Textとlarger typeをsupportする。

conditions: The requirement applies only when the experience uses a custom font.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-BRANDING-0008.review_note: Recovered the conditional Be sure accessibility requirement without requiring a custom font.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-BRANDING-0012.title: Never include Apple trademarks in app names or images

statement.en: Never include Apple trademarks in app names or images.
statement.ja: app nameやimageにApple trademarkを含めない。

conditions: Apply to every app name and image that refers to Apple brands.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-BRANDING-0012.review_note: Recovered the explicit must-not prohibition separately from the general trademark-guidelines recommendation.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0013.title: Ensure content and control colors maintain sufficient contrast

statement.en: Ensure colors in the content layer and controls maintain sufficient contrast.
statement.ja: content layerとcontrolのcolor間で十分なcontrastを維持する。

conditions: Avoid overlapping similar content and control colors when possible.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0013.review_note: Replaced the vague generated Be aware statement with the paragraph's explicit Make sure contrast outcome.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0025.title: Ensure custom colors supply appearance and contrast variants

statement.en: When defining a custom color, ensure it supplies light and dark variants plus an increased-contrast option for each.

conditions: Each increased-contrast option needs substantially greater visual differentiation.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0025.review_note: Recovered the conditional Make sure custom-color asset requirement.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0027.title: Provide noncolor alternatives whenever color conveys information

statement.en: Whenever color conveys information, ensure the same information is available through noncolor cues.
statement.ja: colorでinformationを伝える場合、同じinformationをnoncolor cueでも利用できるようにする。

conditions: Use cues such as text labels or glyph shapes so people with color-vision differences can understand objects and states.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0027.review_note: Recovered the explicit Be sure accessibility requirement as a separate MUST.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0028.title: Ensure colors send the intended message across supported cultures

statement.en: Ensure app colors send the intended message in every supported country and culture.
statement.ja: support対象のすべての国と文化でapp colorが意図したmessageを伝えるようにする。

conditions: Evaluate differing cultural meanings before finalizing the palette.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0028.review_note: Recovered the explicit Make sure outcome separately from the Consider research prompt.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0031.title: Ensure resting content remains legible beneath controls

statement.en: When colorful content can scroll beneath controls, ensure its default or resting state remains clearly legible.

conditions: Apply especially at the initial top position of scrollable content.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0031.review_note: Recovered the second explicit Make sure outcome from the content-layer paragraph.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0033.title: Use a wide-color display to create wide-color assets

statement.ja: wide-color imageのdesignまたはDisplay P3 colorの選択にはwide-color displayを使う。

conditions: The team is designing wide-color images or selecting Display P3 colors.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0033.review_note: Recovered the explicit need-to production prerequisite as a conditional MUST.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-DARK-MODE-0002.title: Ensure the app works visually in both appearance modes

statement.en: Ensure the app looks good in both light and dark appearance modes.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-DARK-MODE-0002.review_note: Retained MUST from the explicit Ensure directive and recorded the runtime Auto-transition context.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-DARK-MODE-0007.title: Ensure full-color images and icons work in both appearances

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-DARK-MODE-0007.review_note: Retained MUST from the explicit Make sure directive and recorded the single-asset and variant branches.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-DARK-MODE-0017.title: Maintain at least a 4.5:1 color contrast ratio

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0013.review_note: Split and retained the source's explicit Never prohibition.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0023.title: Flip forward and backward motion icons in RTL contexts

conditions: Preserve motion meaning, including the direction of speaker sound waves.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0012.title: Do not reproduce Apple products as custom symbols

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0019.title: Do not use SF Symbols for trademarked purposes

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0029.title: Do not customize SF Symbols that depict Apple products

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0031.title: Annotate custom-symbol layers before by-layer animation

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Display comfortable motion in a Full Space

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Request permission before accessing sensitive surroundings data

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Never show excessive motion near the edges of the field of view

conditions: The experience displays animation in a custom environment.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recovered and retained MUST_NOT after confirming the explicit Always avoid directive.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Lower or stop the environmental soundscape when other audio plays

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0033.title: Prevent focused tvOS grid items from overlapping

statement.en: Space unfocused tvOS grid rows and columns to prevent overlap when an item receives focus.
statement.ja: itemがfocusされたとき重ならないよう、unfocusedなtvOS gridのrowとcolumnを配置する。

conditions: The interface uses a tvOS grid whose items enlarge on focus.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0033.review_note: Recovered and retained the explicit Be sure directive for grid focus spacing.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0035.title: Provide enough space around visionOS interactive components

statement.en: Provide enough space around visionOS interactive components for comfortable visual identification and unobscured hover effects.
statement.ja: comfortableなvisual identificationとhover effectのため、visionOS interactive componentの周囲に十分なspaceを設ける。

conditions: Prevent the system hover effect from obscuring other content.
The source gives 60-point center spacing as an example, not an unconditional minimum.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0035.review_note: Recovered and retained the explicit You need directive without promoting the 60-point example to a universal threshold.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0037.title: Keep content and controls distinct

statement.en: Ensure content and controls remain clearly distinct when visual grouping techniques are used.
statement.ja: visual grouping techniqueを使うときcontentとcontrolを明確に区別できる状態に保つ。

conditions: Grouping may use spacing, background shapes, colors, materials, or separators.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0037.review_note: Recovered MUST from the explicit Ensure clause and bound it to the grouping-technique condition.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0040.title: Extend backgrounds and full-screen artwork to display edges

statement.en: Ensure backgrounds and full-screen artwork extend to the edges of the display.
statement.ja: backgroundとfull-screen artworkをdisplayの端まで広げる。

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0040.review_note: Recovered MUST from the explicit Make sure clause and retained both backgrounds and full-screen artwork.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0041.title: Extend scrollable layouts to device-screen edges

statement.en: Ensure scrollable layouts continue to the bottom and sides of the device screen.
statement.ja: scrollable layoutをdevice screenのbottomとsideまで連続させる。

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0041.review_note: Recovered MUST from the explicit ensure clause and preserved the bottom and both side edges.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0048.title: Indicate additional hidden collection items

statement.en: Indicate that additional items exist when a collection can’t display everything at once.
statement.ja: collectionですべてを一度に表示できない場合、追加itemの存在を示す。

conditions: The interface cannot show every item in a large collection simultaneously.
Use a platform-appropriate disclosure control or partial-item cue.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0048.review_note: Recovered MUST from the conditional you need to indicate clause and retained both discovery techniques.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0049.title: Adapt to device and system context changes

statement.en: Ensure every app and game adapts when device or system context changes.
statement.ja: deviceまたはsystem contextが変わるとき、すべてのappとgameを適応させる。

conditions: Handle screen sizes, resolutions, and color spaces.
Handle device orientation.
Handle Dynamic Island, camera controls, and other system features.
Handle external displays, Display Zoom, and resizable iPad windows.
Handle Dynamic Type text-size changes.
Handle localization changes in layout direction, formatting, fonts, and text length.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0049.review_note: Recovered MUST from the explicit needs-to-adapt statement and preserved all six variation groups.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0050.title: Use another adaptation method without system layout tools

statement.en: Use another adaptation method when the interface doesn’t use SwiftUI or Auto Layout.
statement.ja: interfaceでSwiftUIまたはAuto Layoutを使わない場合、別のadaptation methodを使う。

conditions: The app or game does not use SwiftUI or Auto Layout to adapt dynamically.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0050.review_note: Recovered MUST from the explicit conditional need-to-use-alternative-methods clause.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MOTION-0006.title: Provide good default game motion on every platform

statement.en: Ensure a game’s motion looks good by default on every supported platform.
statement.ja: gameのmotionを各supported platformでdefaultのまま良好に表示する。

conditions: Use each device's graphics capabilities to choose defaults people can enjoy without changing settings.
Treat 30–60 fps as a typical smooth range, not an unconditional fixed threshold.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MOTION-0006.review_note: Retained MUST from Make sure, replaced vague generated wording, and preserved the qualified frame-rate range.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MOTION-0014.title: Match peripheral object brightness to surrounding content

statement.en: Match a moving peripheral object’s brightness to the rest of the visible content.
statement.ja: peripheral vision内のmoving objectのbrightnessを他のvisible contentに合わせる。

conditions: An immersive visionOS experience needs to show an object moving in peripheral vision.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MOTION-0014.review_note: Recovered and retained the explicit Make sure directive within its peripheral-motion exception.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MOTION-0017.title: Communicate important information without relying on motion

statement.en: Provide a non-motion way to communicate every important piece of information.
statement.ja: すべてのimportant informationにmotionを使わない伝達方法を提供する。

conditions: Never make motion the only communication channel for important information.
Use alternatives such as haptics or audio where appropriate.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MOTION-0017.review_note: Classified the source's essential accessibility outcome as MUST and recorded both non-motion alternatives.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-WRITING-0024.title: Use correct gesture terms for each device

statement.en: Ensure gesture terminology is correct for each device.
statement.ja: gesture terminologyを各deviceに対して正しくする。

conditions: Use tap rather than click for touch interaction on iPhone and iPad.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-WRITING-0024.review_note: Recovered MUST from Make sure and preserved the touch-device terminology example.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-WRITING-0027.title: Keep empty-state content useful and contextual

statement.en: Ensure empty-state content is useful and fits its context.
statement.ja: empty-state contentをusefulにし、そのcontextへ適合させる。

conditions: An empty state may welcome people, teach the app, or express its voice.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-WRITING-0027.review_note: Recovered MUST from Make sure and retained the allowed empty-state purposes.

HIG-PATTERNS-CHARTING-DATA-0003.title: Make every chart accessible

statement.en: Ensure every chart is accessible.
statement.ja: すべてのchartをaccessibleにする。

conditions: Provide accessibility labels that describe chart values and components.
Provide accessibility elements that let people interact with the chart.
Visible descriptions do not replace accessibility labels or elements.
HIG-PATTERNS-CHARTING-DATA-0003.review_note: Classified the all-chart crucial accessibility outcome as MUST and preserved both required accessibility mechanisms.

HIG-PATTERNS-COLLABORATION-AND-SHARING-0.title: Support universal links with custom collaboration infrastructure

statement.en: When using custom collaboration infrastructure to offer these features, ensure the app supports universal links.
statement.ja: custom collaboration infrastructureでこれらの機能を提供する場合、appがuniversal linkに対応するようにする。

conditions: The app uses custom collaboration infrastructure with Messages integration or system-provided sharing interfaces.
HIG-PATTERNS-COLLABORATION-AND-SHARING-0.review_note: Recovered the embedded Make sure directive and retained its custom-infrastructure condition.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0005.title: Keep every tvOS layered-image background opaque

statement.en: Keep the background layer of every tvOS layered image opaque.
statement.ja: すべてのtvOS layered imageでbackground layerをopaqueに保つ。

conditions: Higher layers may use varying opacity, but the background layer must remain opaque.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0005.review_note: Changed SHOULD to MUST after confirming the supporting must-be-opaque platform constraint and the error produced by a nonopaque background.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0018.title: Require layered images for the tvOS parallax effect

statement.en: Use a layered image whenever a tvOS image needs the parallax effect.
statement.ja: tvOS画像でparallax effectが必要な場合はlayered imageを使う。

conditions: Apply when an image needs to support the system parallax effect.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0018.review_note: Recovered MUST from the explicit required-to-support platform constraint and limited it to images that need parallax.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0019.title: Use a layered image for every tvOS app icon

statement.en: Use a layered image for every tvOS app icon.
statement.ja: すべてのtvOS app iconにlayered imageを使う。

conditions: This requirement applies to the app icon; other focusable images are recommended separately.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0019.review_note: Retained MUST from the explicit app-icon must-use directive without extending it to optional focusable images.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0022.title: Provide runtime layered images for server-retrieved tvOS content

statement.en: Provide .lcr runtime layered images when a tvOS app retrieves layered images from a server.
statement.ja: tvOS appがserverからlayered imageを取得する場合は.lcr runtime layered imageを提供する。

conditions: The tvOS app retrieves layered images from a content server at runtime.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0022.review_note: Retained MUST from the explicit conditional you-must-provide directive and preserved the runtime server-retrieval scope.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0028.title: Apply high-quality filtering above @2x in visionOS

statement.en: Apply high-quality image filtering to visionOS images with resolutions above @2x.
statement.ja: @2xを超えるvisionOS画像にhigh-quality image filteringを適用する。

conditions: The visionOS rasterized image has a resolution higher than @2x.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0028.review_note: Retained MUST after confirming the conditional Be sure directive and its above-@2x threshold.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0018.title: Specify visionOS type styles when using NY

statement.en: Specify every type style a visionOS app needs when it uses NY.
statement.ja: visionOS appでNYを使う場合は必要なtype styleをすべて指定する。

conditions: The visionOS app uses the NY typeface instead of relying only on SF Pro styles.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0018.review_note: Retained MUST after confirming the conditional You need to specify platform requirement for NY type styles.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0021.title: Test nonwhite visionOS text colors in varied contexts

statement.en: Test every nonwhite visionOS text color in a variety of contexts.
statement.ja: white以外のvisionOS text colorをさまざまなcontextでtestする。

conditions: The design replaces the system’s default white text color.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0021.review_note: Retained MUST after confirming the conditional Be sure to test directive for a nondefault text color.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SPATIAL-LAYOUT-0004.title: Use depth only when it adds value

statement.en: Use visionOS depth only where it clarifies, delights, or separates important content.
statement.ja: clarity、delight、important contentの分離に価値がある場合だけvisionOS depthを使う。

conditions: Prefer depth for large, important interface elements.
Review the frequency of depth changes because repeated refocusing can be tiring.
exceptions: Avoid depth that reduces legibility or usability on small objects.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SPATIAL-LAYOUT-0004.review_note: Retained MUST after reviewing the explicit Make sure lead and its value, scale, legibility, and refocusing limits.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TOOLBARS-0031.title: Ensure custom toolbar corner radii are concentric

statement.en: When creating a custom toolbar component, ensure its corner radius is concentric with the bar corners.
statement.ja: custom toolbar componentを作る場合はcorner radiusをbar cornerと同心にする。

conditions: Apply only when a standard toolbar component can't meet the need.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TOOLBARS-0031.review_note: Retained the conditional MUST from the explicit Ensure directive for custom toolbar components.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TOOLBARS-0033.title: Ensure custom Back and Close controls preserve standard behavior

statement.en: Ensure custom Back and Close controls preserve standard appearance, expected behavior, visual fit, and implementation consistency.
statement.ja: custom BackおよびClose controlでstandard appearance、expected behavior、visual fit、implementation consistencyを保つ。

conditions: Apply when creating a custom version instead of the standard Back or Close button.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TOOLBARS-0033.review_note: Retained the conditional MUST from the source's Make sure and Ensure clauses.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TOOLBARS-0040.title: Reinstate standard visionOS toolbar controls after a modal state

statement.en: When a visionOS app exits a modal state, reinstate the window's standard toolbar controls.
statement.ja: visionOS appがmodal stateを終了したらwindowのstandard toolbar controlを復元する。

conditions: Apply when a modal task temporarily replaces the main window's toolbar controls.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TOOLBARS-0040.review_note: Split the exit-state requirement from the optional modal-control recommendation and retained MUST from Be sure.

HIG-PATTERNS-WORKOUTS-0010.title: Ensure clear workout start and stop feedback

statement.en: Ensure clear feedback indicates when a workout session starts or stops.
statement.ja: workout sessionの開始または停止をclear feedbackで示す。

conditions: Apply the feedback to both session-start and session-stop transitions.
HIG-PATTERNS-WORKOUTS-0010.review_note: Recovered the embedded Be sure directive as an atomic MUST separate from control discoverability.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0016.title: Include the full resolution range in HLS playlists

statement.en: Ensure each HLS playlist includes the full range of available content resolutions.
statement.ja: 各HLS playlistに利用可能なcontent resolutionの全範囲を含める。

conditions: Provide variants that let AVFoundation select a resolution appropriate for the playback device.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0016.review_note: Recovered MUST from the explicit needs-to requirement and kept it separate from the quality recommendation.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0018.title: Never mirror unrelated content without explicit choice

statement.en: Never mirror unrelated device content automatically while background AirPlay playback continues.
statement.ja: backgroundのAirPlay playback継続中に無関係なdevice contentを自動mirroringしない。

conditions: Require an explicit user choice before streaming other device content.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0018.review_note: Recovered the crucial explicit-intent prohibition as a source-scoped MUST_NOT.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0019.title: Keep the app functional while AirPlay is active

statement.en: Ensure the app remains functional while AirPlay is active.
statement.ja: AirPlay active中もappをfunctionalに保つ。

conditions: People may navigate away from the playback screen while streaming continues.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0019.review_note: Recovered MUST from the explicit needs-to-remain-functional requirement.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0020.title: Prevent other videos from interrupting AirPlay

statement.en: Ensure other in-app videos do not interrupt active AirPlay playback after navigation.
statement.ja: navigation後に他のin-app videoがactive AirPlay playbackを中断しないようにする。

conditions: Apply after people leave the original playback screen.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0020.review_note: Recovered MUST from the explicit Make sure directive and kept it separate from general app usability.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0022.title: Match custom AirPlay buttons to system controls

statement.en: Ensure custom AirPlay buttons match system-provided controls in appearance and behavior.
statement.ja: custom AirPlay buttonのappearanceとbehaviorをsystem-provided controlに合わせる。

conditions: The app cannot use the system-provided media player.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0022.review_note: Recovered the first atomic MUST from the explicit Be sure directive.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0023.title: Show distinct states in custom AirPlay buttons

statement.en: Ensure custom AirPlay buttons show distinct starting, active, and unavailable states.
statement.ja: custom AirPlay buttonでstarting、active、unavailableのdistinct stateを示す。

conditions: The app cannot use the system-provided media player.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0023.review_note: Recovered the second atomic MUST from the Be sure directive's included state requirements.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APPLE-PAY-0031.title: Make Apple Pay primary after checking active-card availability

statement.en: When checking active-card availability through Apple Pay APIs, make Apple Pay the primary payment option.
statement.ja: Apple Pay APIでactive-card availabilityを確認する場合はApple Payをprimary payment optionにする。

conditions: Apply wherever the app or website uses Apple Pay APIs to check whether an active card is available.
Apple Pay need not be the sole payment option.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APPLE-PAY-0031.review_note: Recovered the conditional explicit must requirement without promoting the broader primary-option recommendation.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APPLE-PAY-0032.title: Exclude Apple Pay branding from custom payment buttons

statement.en: Ensure a custom payment button doesn't display the Apple Pay name or logo.
statement.ja: custom payment buttonにApple Payのnameまたはlogoを表示しない。

conditions: Apply when a custom button initiates the Apple Pay payment process.
An Apple-provided Apple Pay button is the alternative when branded button artwork is needed.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APPLE-PAY-0032.review_note: Recovered the explicit Make sure custom-button branding restriction as a conditional MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APPLE-PAY-0033.title: Show Apple Pay acceptance on custom payment pages

statement.en: Ensure a custom Apple Pay payment page shows acceptance through the Apple Pay mark or a text reference.
statement.ja: custom Apple Pay payment pageでApple Pay markまたはtext referenceによりacceptanceを示す。

conditions: Place the acceptance indicator on the same page as the custom payment button.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APPLE-PAY-0033.review_note: Recovered the second explicit Make sure outcome from the custom-button paragraph as a separate atomic MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APPLE-PAY-0034.title: Never use the Apple Pay mark as a payment button

statement.en: Never use or position the Apple Pay mark as a control that initiates payment.
statement.ja: Apple Pay markをpayment開始controlとして使用または配置しない。

conditions: Use the mark only to communicate Apple Pay acceptance.
A separate custom payment button may initiate Apple Pay when it follows the custom-button requirements.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APPLE-PAY-0034.review_note: Recovered the explicit Never prohibition separately from the general acceptance-mark recommendation.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APPLE-PAY-0035.title: Include a privacy statement on every Apple Pay website

statement.en: Ensure every website that offers Apple Pay includes a privacy statement.
statement.ja: Apple Payを提供するすべてのwebsiteにprivacy statementを含める。

conditions: Apply to every website that offers Apple Pay.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APPLE-PAY-0035.review_note: Split and retained the first explicit website must requirement as an atomic privacy MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APPLE-PAY-0036.title: Follow Apple Pay web acceptable-use guidelines

statement.en: Ensure every website that offers Apple Pay follows the Apple Pay web acceptable-use guidelines.
statement.ja: Apple Payを提供するすべてのwebsiteでApple Pay web acceptable-use guidelinesに従う。

conditions: Apply to every website that offers Apple Pay.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APPLE-PAY-0036.review_note: Split and retained the second explicit website must requirement separately from the privacy statement.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APPLE-PAY-0037.title: Attempt Apple Pay validation before authorization

statement.en: To the extent possible, attempt to validate available Apple Pay information and report problems before authorization.
statement.ja: 可能な範囲で、Apple Payの承認前に利用可能な情報の検証を試み、問題を報告する。

conditions: Privacy protections limit preauthorization access to card type and a redacted shipping address.
Display errors when authorization fails.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APPLE-PAY-0037.review_note: Recovered the explicit need-to preauthorization validation and reporting requirement with its privacy-driven limit.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APPLE-PAY-0038.title: Cancel Apple Pay payments when interruption dismisses the sheet

statement.en: Cancel any in-progress Apple Pay payment when an interruption dismisses its payment sheet.
statement.ja: 中断によってApple Payの支払いシートが閉じた場合、進行中の支払いをキャンセルする。

conditions: Examples include cancellation or timeout during the payment flow.
After dismissal, people can restart by choosing the Apple Pay button again.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APPLE-PAY-0038.review_note: Recovered the explicit you-must cancellation requirement from payment-processing interruption guidance.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APPLE-PAY-0039.title: Clarify subscription terms before the Apple Pay sheet

statement.en: Before showing the Apple Pay payment sheet, ensure people understand the subscription billing frequency and terms.
statement.ja: Apple Pay payment sheetを表示する前にsubscriptionのbilling frequencyとtermsを理解できるようにする。

conditions: Before showing the payment sheet, clarify recurring-payment frequency and other terms of service.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APPLE-PAY-0039.review_note: Recovered the explicit Make sure comprehension requirement while preserving its before-sheet timing.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APPLE-PAY-0040.title: Show the subscription amount charged at authorization

statement.en: Ensure people know the current subscription charge amount when they authorize payment.
statement.ja: paymentをauthorizeする時点で現在のsubscription charge amountが分かるようにする。

conditions: Use the total line to clarify the amount billed at authorization for a subscription payment.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APPLE-PAY-0040.review_note: Recovered the explicit Make sure amount-awareness requirement at the authorization boundary.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APPLE-PAY-0041.title: Keep the Apple Pay mark at least as tall as other payment marks

statement.en: Ensure the Apple Pay mark is no shorter than other payment-brand marks in the payment flow.
statement.ja: Apple Payマークの高さを、その支払いフロー内の他の決済ブランドのマーク以上にする。

conditions: Compare with other payment-brand marks used in the payment flow, not only marks simultaneously displayed beside Apple Pay.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APPLE-PAY-0041.review_note: Recovered the explicit Make sure comparative-size requirement without treating the mark as a payment button.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APPLE-PAY-0042.title: Use Apple trademarks in English

statement.en: Always use Apple Pay and other Apple trademarks in English.
statement.ja: Apple Payおよびその他のApple trademarkは常に英語で表記する。

conditions: Apply even when surrounding text is localized.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APPLE-PAY-0042.review_note: Recovered the explicit Always requirement separately from the direct don't-translate recommendation.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APPLE-PAY-0043.title: Use the Apple Pay mark alongside icon-based payment options

statement.en: When other payment options use icons or logos, use the Apple Pay mark for Apple Pay.
statement.ja: 他のpayment optionがiconまたはlogoを使う場合はApple PayにApple Pay markを使う。

conditions: Applies when any other payment option uses an icon or logo in a payment-selection context.
Text-only Apple Pay is an available alternative only when every payment option is text-only.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APPLE-PAY-0043.review_note: Recovered the conditional explicit must requirement and preserved the all-text-only exception.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AUGMENTED-REALITY-0027.title: Maintain required clear space around AR artwork

statement.en: Maintain clear space of at least 10% of the artwork's height around every AR glyph and badge.
statement.ja: すべてのAR glyphおよびbadgeの周囲にartwork heightの10%以上のclear spaceを確保する。

conditions: Keep other elements out of the clear space and prevent them from occluding the artwork.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AUGMENTED-REALITY-0027.review_note: Raised the generic clear-space lead to MUST after confirming the source calls 10% of glyph or badge height the required minimum.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AUGMENTED-REALITY-0051.title: Update AR scenes 60 times per second

statement.en: Ensure an AR app updates its scenes 60 times per second.
statement.ja: AR appのsceneを1秒あたり60回更新する。

conditions: Apply when placing realistic objects to prevent jumping or flickering that breaks the illusion.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AUGMENTED-REALITY-0051.review_note: Recovered the explicit Make sure frame-rate requirement from the realistic-object guidance.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AUGMENTED-REALITY-0052.title: Test potentially conflicting AR gestures

statement.en: Test an AR app whenever it implements potentially conflicting gestures.
statement.ja: potentially conflicting gestureを実装するAR appをtestする。

conditions: Apply when two gestures can be difficult to distinguish, such as pinch and rotation.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AUGMENTED-REALITY-0052.review_note: Recovered the explicit Be sure to test directive as a separate atomic MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AUGMENTED-REALITY-0053.title: Interpret similar AR gestures correctly

statement.en: Ensure similar AR gestures are interpreted correctly.
statement.ja: 類似するAR gestureを正しく解釈する。

conditions: Apply when the app implements gestures that can conflict with each other.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AUGMENTED-REALITY-0053.review_note: Recovered the explicit Make sure outcome separately from the gesture-testing action.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AUGMENTED-REALITY-0054.title: Face 3D text toward people

statement.en: Ensure text displayed in 3D space faces the person viewing it.
statement.ja: 3D spaceに表示するtextを閲覧者の方へ向ける。

conditions: Apply when critical labels, annotations, or instructions must appear in 3D space.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AUGMENTED-REALITY-0054.review_note: Recovered the first embedded Make sure legibility requirement as an atomic MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AUGMENTED-REALITY-0055.title: Keep 3D text at a constant type size

statement.en: Ensure 3D text uses the same type size regardless of its distance from the labeled object.
statement.ja: 3D textはlabeled objectからの距離にかかわらず同じtype sizeを使う。

conditions: Apply when critical labels, annotations, or instructions must appear in 3D space.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AUGMENTED-REALITY-0055.review_note: Recovered the second embedded Make sure legibility requirement separately from text orientation.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AUGMENTED-REALITY-0056.title: Never alter the AR glyph beyond size and color

statement.en: Never alter the AR glyph except to adjust its size or color.
statement.ja: AR glyphはsizeまたはcolorの調整以外で変更しない。

conditions: Use the Apple-provided AR glyph artwork.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AUGMENTED-REALITY-0056.review_note: Recovered the first explicit Never prohibition and preserved the size-and-color exception.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AUGMENTED-REALITY-0057.title: Never repurpose the AR glyph

statement.en: Never use the AR glyph for a purpose other than starting an ARKit-based experience.
statement.ja: AR glyphをARKit-based experienceの開始以外の目的に使わない。

conditions: Treat the glyph strictly as a control for initiating the experience.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AUGMENTED-REALITY-0057.review_note: Recovered the second explicit Never prohibition as an atomic purpose constraint.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AUGMENTED-REALITY-0058.title: Never use the AR glyph for non-ARKit experiences

statement.en: Never use the AR glyph with an augmented-reality experience that wasn't created using ARKit.
statement.ja: ARKitで作成されていないaugmented-reality experienceにAR glyphを使わない。

conditions: Apply to every use of the AR glyph.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AUGMENTED-REALITY-0058.review_note: Recovered the third explicit Never prohibition as the technology-origin constraint.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AUGMENTED-REALITY-0059.title: Never alter or recolor AR badges

statement.en: Never alter or recolor Apple-provided AR badges.
statement.ja: Apple-provided AR badgeを変更またはrecolorしない。

conditions: Use the downloadable collapsed or expanded badge artwork without modification.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AUGMENTED-REALITY-0059.review_note: Combined the adjacent artwork-alteration and color clauses under one atomic modification prohibition.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AUGMENTED-REALITY-0060.title: Never repurpose AR badges

statement.en: Never use AR badges for purposes other than identifying items viewable in AR using ARKit.
statement.ja: AR badgeをARKitを使ってAR表示できるitemの識別以外の目的に使わない。

conditions: Apply to both collapsed and expanded AR badge artwork.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AUGMENTED-REALITY-0060.review_note: Recovered the badge-purpose Never clause separately from artwork modification.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AUGMENTED-REALITY-0061.title: Never use AR badges for non-ARKit experiences

statement.en: Never use AR badges with an augmented-reality experience that wasn't created using ARKit.
statement.ja: ARKitで作成されていないaugmented-reality experienceにAR badgeを使わない。

conditions: Apply to both collapsed and expanded AR badge artwork.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AUGMENTED-REALITY-0061.review_note: Recovered the badge technology-origin Never clause as a separate atomic prohibition.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AUGMENTED-REALITY-0062.title: Place AR badges in a consistent photo corner

statement.en: Always place an AR badge in the same corner of object photos.
statement.ja: AR badgeをobject photoの常に同じcornerへ配置する。

conditions: Apply consistently across every badged object photo in the app.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AUGMENTED-REALITY-0062.review_note: Recovered the explicit Always placement requirement separately from general visual consistency.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AUGMENTED-REALITY-0063.title: Keep AR badges visible without obscuring details

statement.en: Ensure an AR badge is large enough to see clearly but not so large that it obscures important photo details.
statement.ja: AR badgeを明確に見える大きさにしつつimportant photo detailを隠さない大きさにする。

conditions: Apply when sizing the badge within an object-photo corner.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AUGMENTED-REALITY-0063.review_note: Recovered the explicit Make sure visibility and nonocclusion outcome as one bounded sizing requirement.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GAME-CENTER-0041.title: Center content in achievement images

statement.en: Keep important achievement-image content centered within the system's circular mask.
statement.ja: importantなachievement-image contentをsystemのcircular mask内の中央に保つ。

conditions: Apply when composing every Game Center achievement image.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GAME-CENTER-0041.review_note: Recovered the explicit Be sure centering requirement separately from the size-and-format recommendation.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GAME-CENTER-0045.title: Keep primary leaderboard content visible after cropping

statement.en: Ensure primary leaderboard artwork content remains comfortably visible after system cropping and tvOS focus effects.
statement.ja: system croppingおよびtvOS focus effect後もprimary leaderboard artwork contentを快適に見える状態に保つ。

conditions: Review leaderboard-set crops in iOS, iPadOS, and macOS and layer-edge crops from tvOS focus effects.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GAME-CENTER-0045.review_note: Recovered the explicit Make sure visibility requirement and narrowed it to the four cropping contexts named by the source.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GAME-CENTER-0047.title: Deep-link to the exact challenge start

statement.en: Always deep-link players to the exact mode or level where a Game Center challenge begins.
statement.ja: playerをGame Center challengeが始まる正確なmodeまたはlevelへ常にdeep-linkする。

conditions: Apply to challenge entry from invitation links, the Game Overlay, and the Games app.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GAME-CENTER-0047.review_note: Recovered the explicit Always deep-link requirement separately from optional onboarding flow details.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MACHINE-LEARNING-0017.title: Make calibration easy to cancel at any time

statement.en: Ensure people can easily cancel calibration at any time.
statement.ja: 利用者が、調整をいつでも簡単に取り消せるようにする。

conditions: Avoid judging the person's choice.
No cancellation-specific message is needed; the next attempt to use the feature offers another chance to calibrate.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MACHINE-LEARNING-0038.title: Ensure mistake-handling tools address the consequences

statement.en: Ensure the tools provided for handling mistakes can address their consequences.
statement.ja: 誤りへの対処手段が、その誤りによる影響に対応できるようにする。

conditions: Mistakes can have consequences of different kinds and seriousness; choose tools capable of addressing the relevant consequences.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MACHINE-LEARNING-0038.review_note: Raised the outcome from SHOULD to MUST because the source says the tools must be able to address the consequences.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MACHINE-LEARNING-0046.title: Know the data types a machine-learning feature requires

statement.en: Identify as much as possible about the data types a machine-learning feature requires.
statement.ja: 機械学習の機能に必要なデータの種類を、可能な限り把握する。

conditions: Use this understanding to make design decisions, considering sensitivity and consequences of inaccurate or unreliable results.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MACHINE-LEARNING-0046.review_note: Retained MUST from the conditional You need to directive.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MACHINE-LEARNING-0047.title: Prioritize accuracy and reliability for sensitive-data features

statement.en: Prioritize accuracy and reliability when a machine-learning feature uses sensitive data.
statement.ja: 機微なデータを使う機械学習の機能では、正確さと信頼性を優先する。

conditions: Sensitive-data features can have serious consequences when results are inaccurate or unreliable.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MACHINE-LEARNING-0047.review_note: Retained MUST from the explicit must directive and its sensitive-data condition.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MACHINE-LEARNING-0048.title: Protect user privacy at all times

statement.en: Protect user privacy at all times, regardless of data sensitivity.
statement.ja: データの機微性にかかわらず、利用者のプライバシーを常に保護する。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MACHINE-LEARNING-0048.review_note: Retained MUST from the unconditional privacy must directive.
conditions: Applies to all apps using the documented machine-learning data context.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MACHINE-LEARNING-0051.title: Keep explicitly unwanted content from appearing elsewhere

statement.en: Ensure content people explicitly reject doesn't appear elsewhere in the app.
statement.ja: 利用者が見たくないと明示したコンテンツが、アプリ内の別の場所にも表示されないようにする。

conditions: People explicitly identified the content as unwanted.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MACHINE-LEARNING-0051.review_note: Retained MUST from Ensure and resolved the pronoun through the explicit-feedback context.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MACHINE-LEARNING-0060.title: Never blame people for stalled calibration

statement.en: Never imply that stalled calibration means something is wrong or that people are at fault.
statement.ja: 調整が進まないことについて、何かに異常がある、または利用者に落ち度があると示唆してはならない。

conditions: Calibration progress has stalled and the app provides recovery guidance.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MACHINE-LEARNING-0060.review_note: Retained MUST_NOT from the first explicit Never clause.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MACHINE-LEARNING-0061.title: Never leave stalled calibration without a next step

statement.en: Never leave people without a clear next step when calibration stalls.
statement.ja: 調整が進まなくなったときに、次に何をすればよいか分からないまま利用者を放置してはならない。

conditions: Calibration progress has stalled.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MACHINE-LEARNING-0061.review_note: Retained MUST_NOT from the second explicit Never clause.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MACHINE-LEARNING-0065.title: Always review cross-area effects when reducing mistakes

statement.en: Always consider effects on other areas and overall accuracy when reducing mistakes in one area.
statement.ja: ある領域の誤りを減らすときは、他の領域と全体の精度への影響を常に考慮する。

conditions: A model change is intended to reduce mistakes in one area.
As models evolve, errors can change too; people's preferences can help identify areas worth improving.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MACHINE-LEARNING-0065.review_note: Retained MUST from the unqualified Always directive.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MACHINE-LEARNING-0066.title: Persist correction updates

statement.en: Persist corrections so people do not have to make the same changes again.
statement.ja: 利用者が同じ修正を繰り返さなくて済むように、修正内容を保存する。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MACHINE-LEARNING-0066.review_note: Retained MUST from the explicit Be sure directive.
conditions: People have corrected the feature's result.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MACHINE-LEARNING-0068.title: Verify a correction will improve result quality before learning from it

statement.en: Before using a correction to update a model, make sure it will lead to higher-quality results.
statement.ja: 修正をモデルの更新に使う前に、結果の質が向上することを確認する。

conditions: The app is about to use a correction to update its models.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MACHINE-LEARNING-0068.review_note: Retained MUST from the conditional Make sure quality gate.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MACHINE-LEARNING-0072.title: Verify confidence values correspond to result quality

statement.en: Verify that confidence values correspond to result quality before conveying confidence to people.
statement.ja: 利用者に信頼度を伝える前に、その値が結果の質に対応していることを検証する。

conditions: Confidence does not automatically indicate result quality.
Checking several thresholds or comparing app versions are possible verification methods, not a required test set.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MACHINE-LEARNING-0072.review_note: Retained MUST from You need to and bounded it to confidence presentation.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MACHINE-LEARNING-0083.title: Understand the goal before suggesting alternatives

statement.en: When suggesting an alternative way to achieve a goal, understand the goal well enough to offer a relevant alternative.
statement.ja: 目的を達成する別の方法を提案する場合は、適切な代替案を示せるだけ、その目的を理解する。

conditions: The feature offers an alternative instead of returning no results.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MACHINE-LEARNING-0083.review_note: Retained MUST from You need to and bounded it to the alternative-results branch.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAPS-0005.title: Ensure custom controls contrast with the map

statement.en: Ensure there is enough contrast between custom controls and the map.
statement.ja: custom controlとmapの間に十分なcontrastを確保する。

conditions: Custom controls appear over or adjacent to the map.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAPS-0005.review_note: Retained MUST from the explicit Make sure contrast directive.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAPS-0007.title: Keep place-card content viewable across devices and sizes

statement.en: Ensure place-card content remains viewable across devices and changing window sizes.
statement.ja: deviceやwindow sizeが変わってもplace-card contentを表示可能に保つ。

conditions: The app displays a place card in a map.
A specified style must remain viewable as devices and window sizes change.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAPS-0007.review_note: Retained MUST from Make sure and expressed the supporting Ensure outcome as viewability.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAPS-0030.title: Ensure a place-card style fits the map context

statement.en: Ensure the selected place-card style fits the map's context.
statement.ja: 選択したplace-card styleをmap contextに適合させる。

conditions: Account for map size, annotation density, information needs, and the visibility of nearby places.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAPS-0030.review_note: Retained MUST from Be sure and kept the compact-callout example optional.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAPS-0031.title: Include a map when a place card appears outside a map view

statement.en: Include a map in a place card when the place card isn't displayed within a map view.
statement.ja: place cardをmap view外に表示する場合はplace card内にmapを含める。

conditions: The place card is displayed outside a map view.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAPS-0031.review_note: Retained MUST from the explicit conditional you-must directive.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAPS-0038.title: Match indoor-map elements to the app's visual style

statement.en: Ensure indoor-map area overlays, icons, and text match the app's visual style.
statement.ja: indoor-mapのarea overlay、icon、textをappのvisual styleに合わせる。

conditions: The app provides a custom indoor map.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAPS-0038.review_note: Retained MUST from Make sure and preserved the complete element set.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0008.review_note: Raised the explicit time-critical-only change-message restriction to MUST after reviewing its interruption context.

statement.ja: パスの変更メッセージは、ユーザーが知る必要のある時間的に重要な情報に限って使用する。

conditions: A change message interrupts the person, so reserve it for urgent, consequential updates such as a changed departure gate.
Routine details, such as a customer-service phone-number change, do not warrant a change message.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0024.review_note: Raised the explicit need-to-supply fulfillment information requirement to MUST.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0024.title: Provide enough shipping and pickup information

statement.en: Provide enough fulfillment information for people to know where their items are and when to expect them.
statement.ja: 商品がどこにあり、いつ届くか・受け取れるかを理解できるだけの配送・受け取り情報を提供する。

conditions: Applies to both shipping and pickup fulfillments, including mixed fulfillments within a multi-item order.
Include the estimated arrival time and relevant tracking or pickup information; do not infer unavailable carrier details.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0029.review_note: Raised the precise-moment-only identity request to a privacy and explicit-user-intent MUST.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0029.title: Request identity information at the needed moment

statement.en: Request Wallet identity information only when the current process actually requires it.
statement.ja: 進行中の手続きで本当に必要になった時点に限り、Walletの本人確認情報を要求する。

conditions: Applies to the page-documented in-app/App Clip identity verification on iPhone with iOS 16 or later, subject to current device capability.
Wait until the person is completing the process or transaction requiring verification;0061 separately prohibits premature requests.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0030.review_note: Raised identity-data minimization to MUST under the repository's privacy priority.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0030.title: Minimize requested Wallet identity data

statement.en: Request only the Wallet identity data needed to complete the current task.
statement.ja: 現在の作業を完了するために必要なWalletの本人確認データだけを要求する。

conditions: Applies to the page-documented in-app/App Clip identity verification on iPhone with iOS 16 or later, subject to current device capability.
When only age eligibility is needed, request the relevant age threshold instead of current age or date of birth.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0032.review_note: Raised the supported-device-only verification restriction to a bounded platform-contract MUST.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0032.title: Offer verification only on capable devices

statement.en: Offer Wallet identity verification only when the device can return the identity information being requested.
statement.ja: 要求する本人確認情報を端末が返せる場合に限り、Walletでの本人確認を提供する。

conditions: Applies to the page-documented in-app/App Clip identity verification on iPhone with iOS 16 or later, subject to current device capability.
Do not display Verify with Apple Wallet when that information is unavailable.
0060 independently requires a different verification method when the Wallet method is unavailable.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0033.review_note: Raised accessible placement of textual pass information to MUST.

statement.en: Reserve Wallet pass images for visual content rather than textual pass information.
statement.ja: Walletのパス画像は視覚的な内容に使い、文字情報を埋め込まない。

conditions: Embedded image text is inaccessible, and some devices may not display the image.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0035.review_note: Raised to MUST from the explicit You must purpose-string requirement.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0035.title: Explain the purpose of identity access

statement.en: Provide a clear purpose string explaining why the app needs the requested identity information.
statement.ja: 要求する本人確認情報がアプリに必要な理由を、明確な利用目的の文章で説明する。

conditions: Applies to the page-documented in-app/App Clip identity verification on iPhone with iOS 16 or later, subject to current device capability.
Aim for a brief, complete, direct and specific sentence.
Use sentence case where applicable, avoid passive voice and end with a period, following the page’s writing guidance.
The system displays this explanation in the verification sheet; source legal-purpose examples are not legal advice for a particular app.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0036.review_note: Raised identity-data retention disclosure to MUST because the source calls the explanation essential.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0036.title: Disclose identity-data retention

statement.en: Clearly explain whether identity data will be kept and, if so, for how long.
statement.ja: 本人確認データを保存するかどうかと、保存する場合の期間を明確に説明する。

conditions: Applies to the page-documented in-app/App Clip identity verification on iPhone with iOS 16 or later, subject to current device capability.
Specify the retention duration with PassKit so the system can display an explanation in the verification sheet.
A specific period, indefinite retention, or verification-only use are descriptive API examples, not permission to retain data unnecessarily.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0039.review_note: Classified the exact Wallet order-logo format, size, and background specification as a platform contract.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0039.title: Provide a suitable Wallet order logo

statement.en: Provide a recognizable, high-resolution Wallet order logo using the documented format, size, and background.
statement.ja: 指定の形式・サイズ・背景を用い、見分けやすく高解像度のWallet注文用ロゴを提供する。

conditions: Use PNG or JPEG at 300×300 pixels with a nontransparent background.
Check that the logo is recognizable at both dashboard and detail-view sizes.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0040.review_note: Classified the exact Wallet product-image format, size, and background specification as a platform contract.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0040.title: Provide distinct Wallet product images

statement.en: Provide distinct, high-resolution Wallet product images using the documented format, size, and background.
statement.ja: 指定の形式・サイズ・背景を用い、商品を見分けやすい高解像度のWallet用商品画像を提供する。

conditions: For each product, use PNG or JPEG at 300×300 pixels and a solid, nontransparent background.
Use a straightforward depiction; busy or lifestyle backgrounds can obscure an item at small sizes.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0043.review_note: Raised the direct don't-repeat instruction to MUST_NOT under explicit user intent.

statement.en: Do not repeat a suggestion to add a pass after the person declines it.
statement.ja: パスの追加提案をユーザーが断ったら、同じパスについて繰り返し提案しない。

conditions: Applies after a person declines the suggestion for that pass.
Keeping an Add to Apple Wallet button available for a later user-initiated choice is compatible with this restriction.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0045.review_note: Recovered MUST from the explicit semantic-tags-required clause.

statement.en: Provide semantic tags for poster event tickets and semantic boarding passes so the system can lay them out automatically.
statement.ja: ポスター形式のイベントチケットとセマンティック形式の搭乗券には、自動レイアウトに必要なセマンティックタグを指定する。

conditions: This requirement applies to poster event tickets and semantic boarding passes, not indiscriminately to every pass style.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0046.review_note: Recovered the direct legacy-display compatibility requirement as MUST.

statement.en: Also include pass fields in poster event tickets and semantic boarding passes so they display on older iOS versions.
statement.ja: ポスター形式のイベントチケットとセマンティック形式の搭乗券には、古いiOSでも表示できるようパスフィールドも含める。

conditions: Pass fields accompany the semantic tags for these pass types to support older iOS versions.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0047.review_note: Raised the device-dependent essential-information prohibition to an accessibility MUST_NOT.

statement.en: Do not place essential pass information only in elements that may be unavailable on some devices.
statement.ja: 一部のデバイスで表示されない可能性がある要素だけに、パスの重要な情報を載せてはならない。

conditions: Account for device differences, including the reduced information and image support on Apple Watch.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0049.review_note: Classified semantic tags for airline boarding passes as a Wallet format contract.

statement.en: Use semantic tags for airline boarding passes.
statement.ja: 航空会社の搭乗券にはセマンティックタグを使う。

conditions: Applies to airline boarding passes.
A boarding pass typically represents one trip with an origin and destination.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0050.review_note: Classified pass fields for other transit passes as the complementary Wallet format contract.

statement.en: Use pass fields for non-airline boarding passes.
statement.ja: 航空会社以外の乗車券や乗船券にはパスフィールドを使う。

conditions: Applies to non-airline transportation passes, such as train, bus, boat, or generic-transit passes.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0051.review_note: Classified PNG scale, filename, and structured pass-image dimensions as a platform contract.

statement.en: Create pass images as @2x and @3x PNG assets using the filenames and dimensions for the chosen asset type and pass style.
statement.ja: 選んだ画像の種類とパス形式に対応するファイル名・寸法を用い、@2xと@3xのPNG画像を作成する。

conditions: The specifications apply when using the corresponding supported asset type; they do not require every pass to include every image type.
For non-semantic airline boarding passes, non-airline boarding passes, coupons, non-poster event tickets, generic passes, and store cards: logo.png, 50–160 pt wide and 50 pt high.
For airline boarding passes, poster event tickets, and poster generic passes: primaryLogo.png, 30–126 pt wide and 30 pt high.
For poster event tickets: secondaryLogo.png, 12–135 pt wide and 12 pt high.
For all pass styles: icon.png, 38×38 pt.
For coupons and store cards: strip.png, 375×144 pt.
For event tickets and generic passes: thumbnail.png, 60–90 pt wide and 90 pt high.
For non-poster event-ticket backgrounds: background.png, 343×503 pt. For poster event tickets and poster generic passes: artwork.png, 358×448 pt.
For airline boarding-pass footers: footer.png, 268×15 pt.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0052.review_note: Raised the accessible text-field and semantic-tag alternative to MUST.

statement.en: Provide textual pass information through text fields and semantic tags.
statement.ja: パスの文字情報は、テキストフィールドやセマンティックタグで提供する。

conditions: Embedded image text is inaccessible, and images may not appear on every device.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0053.review_note: Classified Pass Designer or API barcode generation as the required Wallet content path.

statement.en: Add pass barcodes with Pass Designer or the corresponding APIs instead of embedding them in images.
statement.ja: パスのバーコードは画像に埋め込まず、Pass Designerまたは対応するAPIで追加する。

conditions: Applies when the pass includes a barcode.
Pass Designer and the corresponding APIs are alternative supported authoring paths.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0055.review_note: Classified the transparent-PNG thumbnail format and documented dimensions as a platform contract.

statement.en: Export Wallet pass thumbnail artwork with rounded corners as a transparent PNG.
statement.ja: Walletのパスに使うサムネイル画像は角を丸め、透過PNGとして書き出す。

conditions: When an event ticket or generic pass uses a thumbnail, use thumbnail.png at 60–90 pt wide and 90 pt high.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0056.review_note: Classified the pass-background safe area as a layout contract.

statement.en: Keep pass background content within the documented safe area.
statement.ja: パスの背景画像の内容は、規定のセーフエリア内に配置する。

conditions: For poster event tickets and poster generic passes, account for the material strip along the bottom edge.
If the pass contains a barcode, account for its space in the layout.
Pass Designer can preview the layout to help verify placement.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0058.review_note: Retained MUST from the explicit at-minimum need-to merchant-link requirement.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0058.title: Provide a minimum merchant contact link

statement.en: Provide at least a link to the merchant’s website or landing page among Wallet order contact options.
statement.ja: Walletの注文の連絡先として、少なくとも販売者のウェブサイトか案内ページへのリンクを提供する。

conditions: Other possible contact methods include Messages for Business, phone, email, or a support-page link; they do not all become mandatory.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0059.review_note: Recovered the in-both-cases carrier tracking-link requirement as conditional MUST.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0059.title: Provide available carrier tracking links

statement.en: Provide a carrier tracking link whenever one is available.
statement.ja: 配送業者の追跡リンクが利用できる場合は、そのリンクを提供する。

conditions: Applies whether detailed interim carrier statuses are known or only shipped can be reported.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0060.review_note: Recovered the identity-verification fallback as a required completion path.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0060.title: Offer a verification fallback

statement.en: Provide another identity-verification method when Verify with Apple Wallet is unavailable.
statement.ja: Verify with Apple Walletを利用できない場合は、別の本人確認方法を提供する。

conditions: Applies to the page-documented in-app/App Clip identity verification on iPhone with iOS 16 or later, subject to current device capability.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0061.review_note: Raised the premature identity-verification prohibition to MUST_NOT under privacy and explicit user intent.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0061.title: Do not request identity verification prematurely

statement.en: Never request Wallet identity verification before the person is ready for the requiring process or merely to create an account.
statement.ja: 本人確認が必要な手続きを始める準備ができる前や、単なるアカウント作成のために、Walletの本人確認を要求しない。

conditions: Applies to the page-documented in-app/App Clip identity verification on iPhone with iOS 16 or later, subject to current device capability.
