HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0013.review_note: Recovered the one-or-more-actions App Shortcut structure contract as MUST.

HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0014.review_note: Recovered the system-supported maximum of 10 App Shortcuts as MUST.

HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0015.review_note: Recovered the single-optional-parameter constraint as MUST.

HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0016.review_note: Raised the critical full-dialogue information requirement to an audio-accessibility MUST.

HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0017.review_note: Recovered MUST from the explicit You have to app-name requirement.

HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0020.review_note: Recovered the per-shortcut iOS and iPadOS symbol-or-preview representation contract as MUST.

HIG-COMPONENTS-CONTROLS-0008.review_note: Raised the explicit Require security directive to MUST.

HIG-COMPONENTS-CONTROLS-0009.review_note: Raised the locked-device sensitive-information safeguard to a privacy and security MUST.

HIG-COMPONENTS-CONTROLS-0013.review_note: Raised the explicit needs-to symbol-only communication contract to MUST.

HIG-COMPONENTS-CONTROLS-0022.review_note: Raised symbol-state redaction to a conditional privacy and security MUST.

HIG-COMPONENTS-CONTROLS-0023.review_note: Recovered the explicit must-authenticate-and-unlock locked-camera platform contract.

HIG-COMPONENTS-DISCLOSURE-CONTROLS-0007.review_note: Retained MUST from the explicit Make sure disclosure-triangle label-meaning directive.

HIG-COMPONENTS-GAUGES-0001.review_note: Raised the value-and-endpoint labeling requirement to MUST because VoiceOver depends on the visible gauge labels.

HIG-COMPONENTS-LABELS-0007.review_note: Recovered the explicit Make sure custom-style and custom-font legibility requirement as MUST.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SHEETS-0007.review_note: Raised the conditional macOS window-access outcome to MUST from the explicit Make sure directive.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SHEETS-0015.review_note: Recovered the conditional Always pair requirement for Done with Cancel or Back.

HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0002.title: Make live items look live

statement.en: Ensure live items look live through playback or a clear visual marker.
statement.ja: playbackまたは明確なvisual markerによりlive itemがliveに見えるようにする。

conditions: Use a badge, symbol, sash, or equivalent indicator when an item isn't already playing.
HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0002.review_note: Retained MUST from the explicit Make sure directive and recorded the nonplaying-item fallback.

HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0006.title: Provide immediate channel-change feedback

statement.en: Provide immediate visual feedback when people change channels.
statement.ja: channel変更時に即時のvisual feedbackを提供する。

conditions: Confirm the selected channel immediately, including while its stream is loading.
HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0006.review_note: Raised the source's explicitly essential channel-selection feedback outcome to MUST.

HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0015.title: Keep a content footer legible and distinct

statement.en: When using a content footer, ensure its treatment keeps text legible and items distinct from playing content.
statement.ja: content footerを使う場合、textの可読性とitemの再生contentからの区別を保つtreatmentにする。

conditions: Use a subtle treatment such as darkening rather than obscuring the playing content.
HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0015.review_note: Raised the first conditional Be sure footer item to an accessibility MUST.

HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0016.title: Identify the currently playing footer thumbnail

statement.en: When using a content footer, ensure people can identify the thumbnail for the currently playing content.
statement.ja: content footerを使う場合、再生中contentのthumbnailを識別できるようにする。

conditions: Use a badge, tinted progress bar, or equivalent state indicator.
HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0016.review_note: Raised the second conditional Be sure footer item to a current-state identification MUST.

HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0017.title: Match content-footer categories to the EPG

statement.en: When using a content footer, ensure its categories match the electronic program guide.
statement.ja: content footerを使う場合、そのcategoryをelectronic program guideと一致させる。

conditions: The app provides both a content footer and an EPG.
HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0017.review_note: Raised the third conditional Be sure footer item to a cross-view consistency MUST.

HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0018.title: Use predictable content-footer gestures

statement.en: When using a content footer, ensure people can invoke and dismiss it in a simple, predictable way.
statement.ja: content footerを使う場合、単純で予測可能な方法で表示・dismissできるようにする。

conditions: Use an inverse action for dismissal when an action such as swiping up invokes the footer.
HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0018.review_note: Raised the fourth conditional Be sure footer item to a predictable-interaction MUST.

HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0020.title: Prioritize live content

statement.en: Prioritize and elevate live content throughout a live-viewing app.
statement.ja: live-viewing app全体でlive contentを優先して目立たせる。

conditions: Apply the requirement throughout the live-viewing experience.
HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0020.review_note: Recovered MUST from the explicit need-to elevate and prioritize statement.

HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0022.title: Distinguish live content from VOD at a glance

statement.en: On every screen, ensure people can distinguish live content from VOD content at a glance.
statement.ja: すべてのscreenでlive contentとVOD contentを一目で区別できるようにする。

conditions: The app presents live and video-on-demand content.
HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0022.review_note: Recovered the explicit Make sure outcome and retained its every-screen scope.

HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0023.title: Keep playback as the primary action

statement.en: Keep playback as the primary action for live content.
statement.ja: live contentではplaybackをprimary actionにする。

conditions: Additional supported actions remain secondary to playback.
HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0023.review_note: Recovered MUST from the explicit always-needs-to primary-action clause.

HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0026.title: Stop live audio outside the live-viewing context

statement.en: Stop live-content audio when people navigate away from the app's live tab.
statement.ja: appのlive tabから離れた場合はlive-content audioを停止する。

conditions: Navigating away from the live tab ends the live-viewing context.
HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0026.review_note: Recovered the explicit audio-needs-to-stop state transition as MUST.

HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0027.title: Make current EPG information easy to spot

statement.en: When the EPG opens, make the current program, channel, and time easy to spot and current playback easy to resume.
statement.ja: EPGを開いたとき、現在のprogram、channel、timeを見つけやすくし、現在のplaybackへ戻りやすくする。

conditions: People first open the EPG.
HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0027.review_note: Recovered the explicit current-information needs-to-be-easy-to-spot requirement as MUST.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-NOTIFICATIONS-0001.title: Restrict Time Sensitive notifications to current events

statement.en: Use the Time Sensitive interruption level only for an event happening now or within an hour.
statement.ja: Time Sensitive interruption levelは現在発生中または1時間以内に発生するeventだけに使う。

conditions: The notification is relevant in the moment and requires immediate attention.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-NOTIFICATIONS-0001.review_note: Raised the only restriction and supporting Make sure time window to a bounded platform-contract MUST.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-NOTIFICATIONS-0002.title: Never mark marketing notifications Time Sensitive

statement.en: Never use the Time Sensitive interruption level for a marketing notification.
statement.ja: marketing notificationにTime Sensitive interruption levelを決して使わない。

conditions: Marketing permission does not allow a notification to break through Focus or scheduled delivery.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-NOTIFICATIONS-0002.review_note: Retained the explicit Never prohibition and clarified that consent doesn't create an exception.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-NOTIFICATIONS-0003.title: Provide in-app notification settings

statement.en: Provide an in-app settings screen where people can change their notification choices.
statement.ja: notificationの選択を変更できるin-app settings screenを提供する。

conditions: The app requests permission for informational or marketing notifications.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-NOTIFICATIONS-0003.review_note: Retained MUST from the Make sure lead and the supporting must-also-provide clause.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-NOTIFICATIONS-0004.title: Get permission before sending notifications

statement.en: Get permission before sending any notification.
statement.ja: notificationを送信する前にpermissionを取得する。

conditions: The system lets people later change or silence this permission in settings.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-NOTIFICATIONS-0004.review_note: Recovered the general notification permission requirement from the explicit You need to statement.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-NOTIFICATIONS-0006.title: Use communication notifications for direct communications

statement.en: When supporting direct communications such as calls or messages, use communication notifications.
statement.ja: callやmessageなどdirect communicationに対応する場合はcommunication notificationを使う。

conditions: The notification represents a direct communication.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-NOTIFICATIONS-0006.review_note: Classified the conditional system notification-type mapping as a platform contract.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-NOTIFICATIONS-0007.title: Adopt SiriKit intents for communication notifications

statement.en: Adopt SiriKit intents when supporting communication notifications.
statement.ja: communication notificationに対応する場合はSiriKit intentを採用する。

conditions: SiriKit intents let people customize communication-notification behavior with Siri.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-NOTIFICATIONS-0007.review_note: Classified the source's implementation path for communication notifications as a conditional platform contract.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-NOTIFICATIONS-0008.title: Specify an interruption level for every noncommunication notification

statement.en: Specify a system-defined interruption level for every noncommunication notification.
statement.ja: すべてのnoncommunication notificationにsystem-defined interruption levelを指定する。

conditions: The system uses the level to determine when to deliver the alert.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-NOTIFICATIONS-0008.review_note: Retained MUST from the explicit You need to specification requirement.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-NOTIFICATIONS-0009.title: Get an entitlement for Critical notifications

statement.en: Get the required entitlement before sending a Critical notification.
statement.ja: Critical notificationを送信する前にrequired entitlementを取得する。

conditions: Critical notifications can override Ring/Silent, scheduled delivery, and Focus.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-NOTIFICATIONS-0009.review_note: Retained MUST from the explicit you must get an entitlement requirement.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-NOTIFICATIONS-0010.title: Represent each notification's urgency accurately

statement.en: Assign an interruption level that accurately represents each notification's urgency.
statement.ja: 各notificationのurgencyを正確に表すinterruption levelを割り当てる。

conditions: Do not use a high urgency level for low-priority information.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-NOTIFICATIONS-0010.review_note: Raised the source's explicitly essential urgency-accuracy outcome to MUST.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-NOTIFICATIONS-0011.title: Don't send marketing notifications without explicit agreement

statement.en: Don't send marketing or promotional notifications unless people explicitly agree to receive them.
statement.ja: 明示的な同意がない限りmarketingまたはpromotional notificationを送信しない。

conditions: The person has not explicitly opted in to the marketing information.
exceptions: Sending is allowed after explicit agreement, subject to the separate Time Sensitive prohibition.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-NOTIFICATIONS-0011.review_note: Raised the explicit don't-unless consent boundary to a privacy MUST_NOT.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-NOTIFICATIONS-0012.title: Get explicit permission for marketing notifications

statement.en: Get people's explicit permission before sending promotional or marketing notifications.
statement.ja: promotionalまたはmarketing notificationを送信する前に明示的なpermissionを取得する。

conditions: The app wants to send promotional or marketing information.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-NOTIFICATIONS-0012.review_note: Raised the supporting must-receive-explicit-permission clause to a privacy MUST.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-NOTIFICATIONS-0013.title: Describe marketing-notification content before consent

statement.en: Before asking for marketing-notification consent, describe the types of information the app wants to send.
statement.ja: marketing-notification consentを求める前にappが送信するinformation typeを説明する。

conditions: Use an alert, modal view, or other clear permission interface.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-NOTIFICATIONS-0013.review_note: Classified the pre-consent disclosure as a privacy and explicit-intent MUST.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-NOTIFICATIONS-0014.title: Provide clear marketing opt-in and opt-out choices

statement.en: Give people a clear way to opt in to or out of marketing notifications.
statement.ja: marketing notificationへopt inまたはopt outする明確な方法を提供する。

conditions: Present the choice in the marketing-permission interface.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-NOTIFICATIONS-0014.review_note: Classified the clear bidirectional consent choice as a user-intent MUST.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-NOTIFICATIONS-0015.title: Use noncommunication notifications for other tasks

statement.en: Use noncommunication notifications for notification tasks that aren't direct communications.
statement.ja: direct communication以外のnotification taskにはnoncommunication notificationを使う。

conditions: The notification doesn't represent a direct communication such as a call or message.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-NOTIFICATIONS-0015.review_note: Classified the complementary all-other-tasks notification mapping as a platform contract.

HIG-PATTERNS-MODALITY-0003.title: Provide an obvious modal dismissal path

statement.en: Always give people an obvious way to dismiss a modal view.
statement.ja: modal viewをdismissする明確な方法を常に提供する。

conditions: Follow familiar platform conventions for button placement or dismissal gestures.
HIG-PATTERNS-MODALITY-0003.review_note: Retained the explicit Always dismissal requirement as a user-intent MUST.

HIG-PATTERNS-MODALITY-0014.title: Explain potential modal data loss

statement.en: When closing a modal view could lose user-generated content, explain the situation.
statement.ja: modal viewを閉じるとuser-generated contentを失う可能性がある場合、その状況を説明する。

conditions: The person dismisses with either a gesture or a button.
HIG-PATTERNS-MODALITY-0014.review_note: Recovered the first conditional Be sure data-loss requirement as MUST.

HIG-PATTERNS-MODALITY-0015.title: Provide ways to resolve potential modal data loss

statement.en: When closing a modal view could lose user-generated content, give people ways to resolve it.
statement.ja: modal viewを閉じるとuser-generated contentを失う可能性がある場合、解決方法を提供する。

conditions: A resolution can include saving the content before dismissal.
HIG-PATTERNS-MODALITY-0015.review_note: Recovered the second conditional Be sure data-loss requirement as MUST.

HIG-PATTERNS-MODALITY-0016.title: Never show multiple alerts simultaneously

statement.en: Never display more than one alert at the same time.
statement.ja: 同時に複数のalertを表示しない。

conditions: An alert may overlay other content or another type of modal view.
HIG-PATTERNS-MODALITY-0016.review_note: Recovered the explicit Never alert-stacking prohibition as MUST_NOT.

HIG-PATTERNS-SEARCHING-0010.title: Let people clear displayed search history

statement.en: When displaying search history, provide a way for people to clear it.
statement.ja: search historyを表示する場合、消去する方法を提供する。

conditions: The app displays search history.
HIG-PATTERNS-SEARCHING-0010.review_note: Classified the conditional clearing action as a privacy and explicit-user-intent MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0008.title: Get permission before using personal or usage data

statement.en: Get permission before using personal information or usage data with an AI model.
statement.ja: AIモデルで個人情報や利用状況のデータを使う前に、利用者の許可を得る。

conditions: Information can include personal details, messages, photos, and feature-usage data.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0008.review_note: Raised the pre-use permission action to a privacy and explicit-user-intent MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0020.title: Disclose personal-information use and storage

statement.en: Clearly disclose how the app and its AI model use and store personal information.
statement.ja: アプリとAIモデルが個人情報をどのように利用・保存するかを、明確に開示する。

conditions: Give people enough information to make an informed sharing decision.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0020.review_note: Classified the personal-information disclosure outcome as a privacy and informed-consent MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0027.title: Let people reject unwanted AI content and actions

statement.en: Let people dismiss unwanted AI content and revert or retry transformations or actions they reject.
statement.ja: 望まないAIの出力を閉じ、意図に合わない変換や操作を元に戻すか、やり直せるようにする。

conditions: Apply to new generated content, content transformations, and other AI actions.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0027.review_note: Classified the explicit rejection and reversal controls as a user-intent MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0035.title: Protect privacy during server processing

statement.en: For server-based AI processing, take steps to protect people's privacy.
statement.ja: サーバーでAIの処理を行う場合は、利用者のプライバシーを保護する措置を講じる。

conditions: For example, process locally where possible and minimize server sharing; these illustrate safeguards rather than require an entirely local model.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0035.review_note: Classified the server-processing privacy safeguard as a privacy MUST without claiming all processing must be local.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0036.title: Disclose server AI data handling

statement.en: Explain when information may go to a server, what is shared, and what may be stored off-device or used for model training.
statement.ja: 情報がサーバーへ送られる可能性、共有する内容、端末外に保存したりモデルの学習に使ったりするデータを説明する。

conditions: The AI feature sends information to a server.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0036.review_note: Retained the source sentence's making-sure disclosure outcome as a privacy MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0037.title: Minimize personal data after permission

statement.en: After obtaining permission, use only the minimum personal data needed.
statement.ja: 許可を得た後も、使う個人データは必要最小限にとどめる。

conditions: Permission does not remove the data-minimization requirement.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0037.review_note: Classified post-permission data minimization as a privacy MUST and split the Always opt-out clause separately.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0038.title: Get explicit permission for sensitive model data

statement.en: Get explicit permission before using sensitive data for model improvement or storage, and handle it carefully.
statement.ja: 機微なデータをモデルの改善や保存に使う場合は、事前に明示的な許可を得て、慎重に扱う。

conditions: The AI feature needs sensitive data for model improvement or storage.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0038.review_note: Classified the source's explicit-permission condition as a privacy MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0039.title: Enable informed AI data-sharing decisions

statement.en: Enable people to make an informed decision about personal data they share with an AI model.
statement.ja: AIモデルと共有する個人データについて、利用者が必要な情報を得たうえで判断できるようにする。

conditions: Present relevant use, storage, and training information before the sharing decision.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0039.review_note: Classified informed personal-data choice as a privacy and explicit-user-intent MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0040.title: Explain permission benefits clearly

statement.en: When asking to use personal information, explain the benefits concisely, specifically, and clearly.
statement.ja: 個人情報の利用許可を求める際は、その利点を簡潔・具体的で分かりやすく説明する。

conditions: The app asks for permission to use someone's information.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0040.review_note: Classified consent-request clarity as an informed-permission MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0041.title: Disclose training use of personal data

statement.en: Clearly disclose whether the model uses personal information for training or improvement.
statement.ja: モデルの学習や改善に個人情報を使うかどうかを、明確に開示する。

conditions: Make the disclosure before people decide what information to share.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0041.review_note: Classified model-training use disclosure as a privacy and informed-consent MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0050.title: Follow applicable AI policies

statement.en: Review and follow model-specific usage policies and applicable government and regulatory AI policies in each locale where the feature is available.
statement.ja: 生成AI機能を提供する各地域について、モデル固有の利用方針と、適用される政府・規制当局のAI方針を確認し、従う。

conditions: Some uses may be prohibited or subject to additional rules depending on the model and the locale.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0050.review_note: Classified adherence to applicable model and regulatory policy as a legal and platform-contract MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-LIVE-PHOTOS-0001.title: Apply adjustments to every Live Photo frame

statement.en: When the app applies an effect or adjustment to a Live Photo, apply it to the entire photo.
statement.ja: appがLive Photoへeffectまたはadjustmentを適用する場合、photo全体に適用する。

conditions: The app lets people apply effects or adjustments to Live Photos.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-LIVE-PHOTOS-0001.review_note: Raised the conditional full-photo outcome to MUST from the supporting make-sure sentence.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-LIVE-PHOTOS-0008.title: Offer still conversion when full-frame adjustment is unavailable

statement.en: If the app can't apply an adjustment to the entire Live Photo, let people convert it to a still photo.
statement.ja: Live Photo全体へadjustmentを適用できない場合、still photoへconvertできるようにする。

conditions: The app offers Live Photo effects or adjustments but doesn't support applying them to every frame.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-LIVE-PHOTOS-0008.review_note: Classified the documented alternative as a conditional user-intent and content-integrity MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-LIVE-PHOTOS-0010.title: Preview complete Live Photos before sharing

statement.en: Before sharing a Live Photo, let people preview its complete contents.
statement.ja: Live Photoをshareする前にcomplete contentをpreviewできるようにする。

conditions: The app supports photo sharing.
The preview includes the Live Photo's audio and extra frames.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-LIVE-PHOTOS-0010.review_note: Classified complete-content preview as a privacy and explicit-sharing-intent MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAZAMKIT-0001.title: Obtain approval before storing recognized songs

statement.en: Before storing recognized songs in iCloud, obtain the person's approval.
statement.ja: recognized songをiCloudへ保存する前に本人のapprovalを得る。

conditions: The app can store songs recognized with ShazamKit in the person's iCloud library.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAZAMKIT-0001.review_note: Raised the opt-in control to an explicit-user-intent MUST and preserved its before-storage timing.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAZAMKIT-0003.title: Request microphone access for recognition

statement.en: Before using the device microphone for ShazamKit recognition, request access.
statement.ja: ShazamKit recognitionにdevice microphoneを使う前にaccessをrequestする。

conditions: The app needs the device microphone to obtain an audio sample.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAZAMKIT-0003.review_note: Recovered the source's explicit must-request permission requirement.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAZAMKIT-0005.title: Limit recognition recording to the required sample

statement.en: Record recognition audio only as long as needed to obtain the sample.
statement.ja: recognition audioは必要なsampleを取得する時間だけrecordする。

conditions: The person granted microphone access for audio recognition.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAZAMKIT-0005.review_note: Classified the source's privacy-specific only-duration boundary as MUST.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Make app intentions clear from the start

statement.en: Make the app's intentions clear from the first interaction.
statement.ja: 最初のinteractionからappのintentionを明確にする。

conditions: People need this context before deciding whether to continue.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Classified the explicit from-the-start transparency outcome as a user-intent MUST.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Explain permission requests

statement.en: When asking for permission, provide a clear rationale.
statement.ja: permissionを求めるとき、明確なrationaleを提供する。

conditions: Explain why the app needs the requested access.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Classified permission rationale as a privacy and informed-intent MUST.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Disclose data collection and use

statement.en: When collecting data, disclose what you collect and how you use it.
statement.ja: dataを収集するとき、収集内容と利用方法を開示する。

conditions: When gathering data, clearly explain what is collected and how it is used.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Revalidated conditional privacy disclosure under the existing MUST decision policy; no additional before-provision timeline is inferred from the source sentence.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Minimize data collection

statement.en: Collect only the data the product needs to function.
statement.ja: productのfunctionに必要なdataだけを収集する。

conditions: Do not expand collection beyond functional need.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Classified the source's only-needed data-minimization boundary as MUST.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Protect data from misuse and harm

statement.en: Protect data against foreseeable misuse, harm, abuse, and unintended consequences.
statement.ja: foreseeableなmisuse、harm、abuse、unintended consequenceからdataを保護する。

conditions: Evaluate both intentional abuse and unintended downstream effects.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Classified the explicit information-safety outcome as a security MUST.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Prioritize accessibility from the start

statement.en: Treat accessibility as a priority from the start.
statement.ja: 最初からaccessibilityをpriorityとして扱う。

conditions: Integrate accessibility into initial product and interaction decisions.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Classified the explicit from-the-start accessibility priority as MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APPLE-PAY-0047.title: Limit a product-page purchase to its individual item

statement.en: When Apple Pay starts from a product detail page, include only that individual item and exclude other cart items.
statement.ja: 商品詳細ページからApple Payで購入する場合は、その商品だけを対象とし、カート内のほかの商品を含めない。

conditions: Applies only to the optional product-detail purchase route.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APPLE-PAY-0047.review_note: Reviewed additional atomic guidance 2026-09-08: The source says these purchases need to be for an individual item only; this conditional boundary protects explicit purchase intent.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APPLE-PAY-0057.title: Accurately show a preauthorized amount

statement.en: When preauthorizing a specific amount, ensure the payment sheet accurately reflects that amount.
statement.ja: 特定の金額について支払いを事前承認する場合は、その金額を支払いシートに正確に反映する。

conditions: Applies when a specific amount is preauthorized, not to every transaction with unknown final costs.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APPLE-PAY-0057.review_note: Reviewed additional atomic guidance 2026-09-08: Recover the paragraph’s conditional be-sure requirement separately from0028’s broader additional-cost disclosure.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APPLE-PAY-0070.title: Keep Apple Pay out of plural and possessive forms

statement.en: Never pluralize the name Apple Pay or use it in a possessive form.
statement.ja: Apple Payという名称を複数形や所有格にしてはならない。

conditions: Applies to written uses of the Apple Pay product name.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-APPLE-PAY-0070.review_note: Reviewed additional atomic guidance 2026-09-08: Paragraph236 explicitly says never for both grammatical transformations. Apple's trademark naming guidance only; no external legal analysis.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0041.title: Provide appearance variants for alternate app icons

statement.en: Ensure each alternate iOS or iPadOS app icon has its own dark, clear, and tinted appearance variants.
statement.ja: iOSまたはiPadOSの代替アプリアイコンごとに、dark、clear、tintedの外観バリエーションを用意する。

conditions: Applies when alternate icons are offered on iOS or iPadOS.
The page also describes system generation of variants that are not supplied; this requirement does not mandate drawing every variant manually.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0041.review_note: Reviewed additional atomic guidance 2026-09-08: The note explicitly requires per-alternate appearance variants; preserve the automatic-generation context from the same section.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0042.title: Keep alternate and variant icons within App Review Guidelines

statement.en: Ensure all alternate and appearance-variant app icons comply with the App Review Guidelines.
statement.ja: すべての代替アプリアイコンと外観バリエーションを、App Review Guidelinesに従うものにする。

conditions: These icons are subject to app review, as is the default icon.
Appearance variants apply on iOS, iPadOS, and macOS. Alternate-icon support applies on iOS, iPadOS, tvOS, and compatible apps running in visionOS.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0042.review_note: Reviewed additional atomic guidance 2026-09-08: Resolve atomicity by adding the explicit must-adhere obligation separately from0015’s MAY feature; retain app-review context without duplicating a second standalone submission rule or interpreting external policy.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0065.title: Get permission before irreversible AI tasks

statement.en: Get permission before performing an irreversible or potentially problematic AI task on a person's behalf.
statement.ja: 利用者に代わって、取り消せない操作や問題を起こし得るAIの処理を行う前に、許可を得る。

conditions: This specific permission prerequisite is distinct from0010's consideration of consequences and0049's generally-confirm-significant-actions recommendation.
Permission does not erase0048's separate guidance to avoid automating destructive or hard-to-undo actions.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0065.review_note: Reviewed additional atomic guidance 2026-09-08: Paragraph34's mixed lead explicitly combines Consider consequences with get permission before irreversible/problematic tasks. Split the unqualified permission prerequisite under the repository explicit-intent policy instead of weakening it with the neighboring Consider or Generally clauses.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SIRI-0003.title: Exclude advertising from Siri content

statement.en: Never include advertisements, marketing, or in-app purchase sales pitches in content Siri delivers.
statement.ja: Siriが提供するコンテンツに、広告、マーケティング、アプリ内購入の売り込みを含めない。

conditions: Applies to content delivered by Siri, not all marketing outside that experience.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SIRI-0003.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph19 explicitly prohibits advertising; preserve existing MUST_NOT and prioritize the requested experience. Explicitly record the reviewed strength independent of the edited display title.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SIRI-0006.title: Support audible and visual Siri delivery

statement.en: Ensure Siri can deliver app-provided responses both audibly and visually.
statement.ja: アプリが提供する応答を、Siriが音声と画面の両方で伝えられるようにする。

conditions: Siri chooses the delivery method appropriate to the device and current situation; this does not require both methods to occur simultaneously.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SIRI-0006.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph33: retain the existing accessibility/platform-delivery MUST classification; the lead says Provide, while0020 has explicit make-sure support. Explicitly record the reviewed strength independent of the edited display title.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SIRI-0010.title: Respect language and parental restrictions

statement.en: Ensure app-provided Siri responses use appropriate language and respect parental controls.
statement.ja: アプリが提供するSiriの応答では、適切な言葉を使い、保護者による制限を尊重する。

conditions: Account for explicit-content and rating restrictions and for nearby people hearing an audible response.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SIRI-0010.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph43 retains the existing user-control MUST classification; offensive dialogue is independently prohibited by0022. Explicitly record the reviewed strength independent of the edited display title.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SIRI-0015.title: Use custom responses only when needed

statement.en: Provide a custom Siri response only when built-in responses do not meet the app’s needs.
statement.ja: 標準の応答でアプリの必要を満たせない場合に限り、Siriの応答を独自に定義する。

conditions: Assess built-in responses before providing a custom response.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SIRI-0015.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph21 explicitly says Only; preserve the conditional MUST rather than requiring custom responses. Explicitly record the reviewed strength independent of the edited display title.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SIRI-0017.title: Expose Siri functionality with App Intents

statement.en: Use the App Intents framework to make the app’s features and content available to Apple Intelligence for Siri.
statement.ja: Siriと連携するため、App Intentsフレームワークでアプリの機能とコンテンツをApple Intelligenceに公開する。

conditions: Applies when making the app work with Siri in the documented Apple Intelligence integration context; this is not a claim of feature availability on every listed device.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SIRI-0017.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph4 says has to; preserve mandatory integration prerequisite without inferring SDK or device availability. Explicitly record the reviewed strength independent of the edited display title.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SIRI-0018.title: Customize follow-up dialogue for clarity

statement.en: When asking a Siri follow-up question, customize the default dialogue so the question is clear.
statement.ja: Siriで追加の質問をするときは、質問が明確になるよう標準の応答文を調整する。

conditions: Applies when custom schema responses ask a follow-up question.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SIRI-0018.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph29 says be sure; preserve conditional MUST. Explicitly record the reviewed strength independent of the edited display title.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SIRI-0020.title: Make voice responses self-contained

statement.en: Ensure Siri voice responses convey essential information without depending on visual elements.
statement.ja: Siriの音声応答だけで、画面の要素に頼らず必要な情報が伝わるようにする。

conditions: Applies when a response is delivered without a visual interface.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SIRI-0020.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph33 explicitly says make sure; prioritize nonvisual access. Explicitly record the reviewed strength independent of the edited display title.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SIRI-0021.title: Keep necessary device references accurate

statement.en: When a Siri response needs to name a device, ensure the reference is accurate and makes sense in context.
statement.ja: Siriの応答で端末を特定する必要がある場合は、その表現が正確で、状況に合っていることを確認する。

conditions: Device-specific wording is conditional, not required for every response.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SIRI-0021.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph39 says if and make sure; preserve conditional MUST. Explicitly record the reviewed strength independent of the edited display title.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SIRI-0022.title: Exclude offensive Siri dialogue

statement.en: Never include offensive language in app-provided Siri dialogue.
statement.ja: アプリが提供するSiriの応答文に、不快感を与える攻撃的な言葉を含めない。

conditions: Applies to dialogue text the app supplies.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SIRI-0022.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph43 explicitly says Don’t include; retain existing MUST_NOT protecting the interaction. Explicitly record the reviewed strength independent of the edited display title.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SIRI-0024.title: Do not impersonate Siri

statement.en: Never impersonate Siri or attempt to reproduce the functionality Siri provides.
statement.ja: Siriになりすましたり、Siriが提供する機能を再現しようとしたりしない。

conditions: Applies to app-provided interactions and responses in the Siri integration context.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SIRI-0024.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph50 explicitly says Never; retain platform-reserved behavior restriction without expanding beyond Siri integration. Explicitly record the reviewed strength independent of the edited display title.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SIRI-0025.title: Do not imply responses come from Apple

statement.en: Never provide an app response that appears to come from Apple.
statement.ja: Appleが発信したように見えるアプリの応答を提供しない。

conditions: Applies to attribution of the app’s response.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SIRI-0025.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph50 prohibits false Apple attribution; prioritize transparent user understanding. Explicitly record the reviewed strength independent of the edited display title.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SIRI-0026.title: Do not use Siri-reserved phrases

statement.en: Never use Siri-reserved phrases such as “Call 911” or “Hey Siri” in app responses.
statement.ja: アプリの応答で、「Call 911」や「Hey Siri」などのSiri専用フレーズを使わない。

conditions: These are examples of reserved phrases, not an exhaustive list or localized emergency-service instructions.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SIRI-0026.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph50 explicitly prohibits reserved phrases; scope is system-reserved Siri behavior, not independent emergency guidance. Explicitly record the reviewed strength independent of the edited display title.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SIRI-0027.title: Localize only Hey in Hey Siri

statement.en: When localizing “Hey Siri,” translate only “Hey” using Apple’s accepted wording for the locale.
statement.ja: 「Hey Siri」を現地語にする場合は、対象の言語・地域でAppleが認める表記を用い、「Hey」だけを翻訳する。

conditions: The source table provides accepted locale-specific forms; do not invent a translation or require a change where the accepted form stays “Hey Siri.”
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SIRI-0027.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph52 and table54 state only-Hey; retain MUST with locale context. Explicitly record the reviewed strength independent of the edited display title.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SIRI-0028.title: Keep the Siri trademark untranslated

statement.en: Never translate the name Siri in a localized “Hey Siri” phrase.
statement.ja: 現地語の「Hey Siri」でも、Siriという名前は翻訳しない。

conditions: Siri remains an Apple trademark in the localized phrase.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SIRI-0028.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph52 explicitly says never translated; preserve MUST_NOT and trademark/legal priority. Explicitly record the reviewed strength independent of the edited display title.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MACHINE-LEARNING-0001.title: Always make providing explicit feedback a voluntary task

statement.en: Always make providing explicit feedback voluntary.
statement.ja: 明示的なフィードバックの提供は、常に利用者の任意とする。

conditions: The app requests feedback; communicate its benefit without making participation feel mandatory.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MACHINE-LEARNING-0001.review_note: Row43 explicitly says Always; retain MUST and voluntary-user-intent priority. Explicitly record the reviewed strength independently of display-title wording.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MACHINE-LEARNING-0015.title: Make sure people know how to perform calibration successfully

statement.en: Make sure people know how to complete calibration successfully.
statement.ja: 利用者が、調整を成功させるための方法を理解できるようにする。

conditions: After people choose to participate, provide an explicit goal and progress toward it.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MACHINE-LEARNING-0015.review_note: Row100 explicitly says Make sure; preserve MUST and comprehensibility without requiring the Face ID example UI. Explicitly record the reviewed strength independently of display-title wording.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MACHINE-LEARNING-0024.title: Always balance the benefits of a feature with the effort required to make a correction

statement.en: Always balance a feature's benefits against the effort people need to correct its mistakes.
statement.ja: 機能がもたらす利点と、その誤りを利用者が修正する手間の釣り合いを常に考慮する。

conditions: A feature can lose its value if correcting it feels harder than performing the task manually.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MACHINE-LEARNING-0024.review_note: Row149, Corrections: explicit Always supports existing MUST; retain the tradeoff rather than inventing a numerical correction-effort threshold. Explicitly record the reviewed strength independently of display-title wording.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MACHINE-LEARNING-0025.title: Never rely on corrections to make up for low-quality results

statement.en: Never rely on people's corrections to compensate for low-quality results.
statement.ja: 質の低い結果を埋め合わせるために、利用者による修正を当てにしてはならない。

conditions: Corrections can reduce a mistake's impact, but they do not substitute for the feature producing useful results.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MACHINE-LEARNING-0025.review_note: Row151, Corrections: explicit Never supports existing MUST_NOT; repair malformed EN and weak Japanese without changing the prohibition. Explicitly record the reviewed strength independently of display-title wording.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Support accessibility in immersive experiences

statement.en: Ensure immersive apps and games support the accessibility features people use to personalize device interaction.
statement.ja: 没入型のアプリやゲームで、利用者が端末の操作方法を調整するためのアクセシビリティ機能に対応する。

conditions: Applies to the documented visionOS immersive experience; it does not invent a specific accessibility API or feature list.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Reviewed additional atomic guidance 2026-09-08: Paragraph32 explicitly calls this essential. Separate the accessibility obligation from0005’s general recommendation to offer multiple ways to use the experience.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MACHINE-LEARNING-0088.title: Minimize calibration information

statement.en: Collect only the information essential for calibration.
statement.ja: 事前の調整・情報入力では、本当に必要な情報だけを収集する。

conditions: Applies to information requested during calibration, not a direction to collect data for every feature.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MACHINE-LEARNING-0088.review_note: Reviewed additional atomic guidance 2026-09-08: Paragraph88 gives an unqualified only-most-essential privacy boundary. Apply the repository policy for privacy/data-minimization requirements;0035’s recommendation to infer remaining values is not the same collection limit.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0005.title: Always get permission before deleting Wallet passes

statement.en: Always get permission before deleting a pass from Wallet.
statement.ja: Walletからパスを削除する前に、必ずユーザーの許可を得る。

conditions: An in-app setting can let the person choose manual deletion or authorize automatic deletion.
An alert is another option when needed; the source does not require both a setting and an alert, or a new alert after valid prior authorization.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0005.review_note: Passes row 16 explicitly requires permission. Preserve MUST, while treating settings and necessary alerts as permission mechanisms rather than cumulative requirements. Explicitly record the reviewed strength independently of display-title wording.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0012.title: Ensure sufficient contrast between background and text colors

statement.en: Ensure sufficient contrast between pass text and its background.
statement.ja: パスの文字と背景の間に十分なコントラストを確保する。

conditions: Check labels against both solid-color backgrounds and background images.
Text over a strip image also needs sufficient contrast.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0012.review_note: Designing passes row 56 and Strip image row 175 support legibility across both background forms. Preserve MUST; accessibility has priority over platform-common styling. Explicitly record the reviewed strength independently of display-title wording.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0044.title: Never use change messages for marketing or noncritical communication

statement.en: Never use pass change messages for marketing or other noncritical communication.
statement.ja: パスの変更メッセージを、宣伝や緊急性のない連絡に使用してはならない。

conditions: Applies to change messages that interrupt the person, not to every update of stored pass information.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0044.review_note: Passes row 26 explicitly says never for marketing and other noncritical communication. Preserve MUST_NOT and the interruption-specific scope. Explicitly record the reviewed strength independently of display-title wording.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0057.title: Match the customer-confirmed final price

statement.en: Ensure the price in a Wallet order matches the final price the customer confirmed.
statement.ja: Walletの注文に表示する金額を、顧客が確認した最終金額と一致させる。

conditions: Applies to the order price shown to the customer.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0057.review_note: Paragraph285 explicitly says make sure; prioritize informed purchase intent without providing financial advice. Explicitly record the reviewed strength independently of display-title wording.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0067.title: Prioritize tracking over recommendations

statement.en: When recommending an app or other services on a fulfillment screen, ensure order-tracking information takes priority.
statement.ja: 配送・受け取りの画面でアプリや別のサービスを勧める場合も、注文追跡の情報を優先する。

conditions: Applies when recommendations share the fulfillment screen; it does not require including recommendations.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0067.review_note: Reviewed additional atomic guidance 2026-09-08: Paragraph307 explicitly says be sure. Separate this conditional priority obligation from0025’s general screen-focus recommendation.

additional_rules.title: Consider setting a custom dismissal time for an ended Live Activity

statement.en: Evaluate whether a custom dismissal time is appropriate after a Live Activity ends.
statement.ja: Live Activity終了後にカスタム消去時刻を設定することが適切か検討する。

conditions: The Live Activity has ended and retaining a short-lived summary may help people.

rationale.en: A proportional dismissal time can preserve a useful summary without keeping stale activity visible too long.
rationale.ja: 適切な消去時刻は、古い情報を長く残さずに有用な概要を一時的に保持できます。

additional_rules.review_note: Split from the source lead's consider clause so optional guidance is not raised to MUST.

additional_rules.title: Ensure content remains legible in both appearance modes

statement.en: Ensure content remains comfortably legible in both appearance modes under relevant accessibility settings.
statement.ja: 関連するaccessibility settingの下でもcontentを両appearance modeで快適に読める状態にする。

conditions: Test Dark Mode with Increase Contrast and Reduce Transparency both separately and together.

rationale.en: Appearance and accessibility combinations can reduce contrast enough to make content illegible.
rationale.ja: appearanceとaccessibility設定の組み合わせによりcontrastが低下し、contentが読めなくなる場合があります。

additional_rules.review_note: Split the explicit make-sure legibility outcome from the testing action so the accessibility requirement remains atomic.

additional_rules.title: Always let people opt out of personal-data use

statement.en: Always provide a clear way for people to opt out of personal-data use.
statement.ja: personal dataの使用をopt outする明確な方法を常に提供する。

conditions: The AI feature uses personal information or usage data after obtaining permission.

rationale.en: Ongoing control lets people withdraw consent after initially permitting data use.
rationale.ja: 継続的なcontrolにより、初回permission後でもdata useへのconsentを撤回できます。

additional_rules.review_note: Split the explicit Always opt-out requirement from post-permission data minimization.

additional_rules.title: Offer choices when using people's data

statement.en: Offer appropriate choices when using people's data to teach or evaluate an AI model.
statement.ja: AI modelのteachingまたはevaluationにpeople's dataを使う場合、適切なchoiceを提供する。

conditions: The dataset includes data from people.

rationale.en: Data choices preserve informed control over personal information used in model development.
rationale.ja: data choiceはmodel developmentに使われるpersonal informationへのinformed controlを保ちます。

additional_rules.review_note: Split the privacy and explicit-user-intent choice from the same sentence's separate license requirement.
